findings.evidence: grep: `TauCeti/Topology/Spectral/ProConstructible.lean:143:theorem Set.Finite.isProConstructible_biUnion`, `:150:theorem Finset.isProConstructible_biUnion`, both between `:73:namespace TauCeti` and `:376:end TauCeti`. `grep -rn "open .*_root_\.Set" TauCeti` returns only the two lines this PR adds — no other file in the repo needs the escape, and ProConstructible.lean had no other importer before this PR.
findings.fix: Declare them as `theorem _root_.Set.Finite.isProConstructible_biUnion` and `theorem _root_.Finset.isProConstructible_biUnion`, matching the repo convention (96 `_root_.`-prefixed declarations, e.g. `TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/Basic.lean:75 lemma _root_.ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_continuousLinearEquiv`); then revert both `open _root_.Set` lines to `open Set`.
findings.issue: `theorem Set.Finite.isProConstructible_biUnion` (line 143) and `theorem Finset.isProConstructible_biUnion` (line 150) are declared inside `namespace TauCeti` (opened line 73, closed line 376), so they land as `TauCeti.Set.Finite.…` and `TauCeti.Finset.…` rather than in the root `Set.Finite`/`Finset` namespaces the names claim. The resulting `TauCeti.Set` namespace makes `open Set` ambiguous in any file inside `namespace TauCeti.*`, which is exactly why this PR must write `open _root_.Set` at PatchPresentation.lean:64 and SpvOfIdeal/Spectral.lean:124.

summary: The new theorem name is correct and matches its sibling precedent. But this PR is the first consumer of TauCeti/Topology/Spectral/ProConstructible.lean and has to write `open _root_.Set` in two files to dodge a namespace collision caused by two declarations there that were meant for the root namespace but land under `TauCeti.`.
